title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Japanese Derby has finally arrived, and Matikanefukukitaru burns with eagerness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Always in her element to ward off evil spirits, Matikanefukukitaru is confident that this monster of a Derby will not overwhelm her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She heads to the track determined to push herself to her limits.
